items.title: India targets creating homegrown GPUs within 2 years and plans to commercialize indigenous SHAKTI and VEGA processors
items.summary: MeitY Secretary S. Krishnan says India plans to develop its own GPU under Semiconductor Mission 2.0, with a target of approximately two years. The country is also looking to commercialize its SHAKTI and VEGA RISC-V processors, expand domestic server production, and attract more semiconductor investment. Krishnan sees the AI boom as a potential repeat of the Y2K-era opportunity that helped India's IT services industry grow
items.title_original: India targets creating homegrown GPUs within 2 years and plans to commercialize indigenous SHAKTI and VEGA processors
items.title_en: India targets creating homegrown GPUs within 2 years and plans to commercialize indigenous SHAKTI and VEGA processors

items.title_bilingual: 印度的目标是在两年内打造国产 GPU，并计划将本土 SHAKTI 和 VEGA 处理器商业化 / India targets creating homegrown GPUs within 2 years and plans to commercialize indigenous SHAKTI and VEGA processors
items.summary_zh: MeitY 秘书 S. Krishnan 表示，印度计划在半导体使命 2.0 下开发自己的 GPU，目标是大约两年。该国还寻求将其 SHAKTI 和 VEGA RISC-V 处理器商业化，扩大国内服务器生产，并吸引更多半导体投资。克里希南 (Krishnan) 认为人工智能热潮可能会重复千禧年时代的机遇，帮助印度 IT 服务业发展
